texts: Hello there! Welcome to the region of VARROW! / My name is MARISOL FENN, but everyone calls me PROF. FENN. / I study the creatures we call WILDKIN.
This little one is a Sproutle. / Wildkin live in every meadow, cave and lake of VARROW. / Some people battle with them, some study them... and some, like me, simply want to understand them.
Now, tell me a little about yourself. What is your name?
Right! So your name is REN!
This is my grandkid. / You two have been neighbors and rivals since you could walk. / What was their name again?
That's right! VEX! Always one step ahead... or so they claim.
REN! Your very own Wildkin adventure is about to begin! / A world of dreams, discovery and battles awaits. / Come visit my lab when you are ready!
